sloka: निष्फलाः खलु संवृत्ताः शरा वासुकितेजसः ।आदत्तं यैः सुसङ्ग्रामे रिपूणां मम जीवितम् ।। ६.५१.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: niṣphalāḥ khalu saṁvṛttāḥ śarā vāsukitejasaḥ ।ādattaṁ yaiḥ susaṅgrāme ripūṇāṁ mama jīvitam ।। 6.51.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"
translations.hindi: मेरे भाई के दुष्ट कुपुत्र ने, राक्षसी कपटबुद्धि से, इन सीधे - सौदे पराक्रमी लोगों को धोखा दिआ है
